cand.title: Opened a Tlajomulco distribution center and announced MXN 3.75 billion of Jalisco investment for 2026–2031, with up to 6,000 jobs.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Verified relationship candidates, not verified hotel buyers: Willinton Giraldo Bedoya, Director de Expansión; Gustavo Antonio García Cárdenas, Director de operaciones; Jonathan Magdaleno, Coordinador de RR. HH. Tiendas in Zapopan; and Gabriel Luciano Baldini, CEO. Expansion/operations/local HR are relevant referral routes; no evidence establishes their hotel-contract authority.
findings.futureEdition: No dated future conference, meeting, inauguration or event edition was identified for November 2026–May 2028. The verified forward activity is a corporate expansion plan: FEMSA announced MXN 3.75 billion of Jalisco investment for 2026–2031, up to 6,000 jobs, and additional distribution centres contemplated toward 2028. These are plans, not event dates or hotel demand commitments; the 2028 reference does not establish activity by May 2028.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo could suit visiting expansion/operations leaders, supplier meetings or off-site training if Bara confirms travel and meeting needs. Marriott describes a city hotel near Expo Guadalajara/Plaza del Sol with guestrooms, catering and meeting facilities. No Bara participation at Expo Guadalajara was verified. The CEDIS is on the Guadalajara–El Salto road, so Expo proximity alone does not prove commute convenience. A city-business proposition is more defensible than a resort incentive pitch; no resort programme was identified.
findings.venueCommitments: Historical commitment only: the Tlajomulco distribution centre on the Guadalajara–El Salto road was inaugurated on 8 September 2026. It is an operating logistics facility, not a contracted hotel. No future meeting venue, incumbent accommodation hotel or hotel commitment was identified in the reviewed evidence.
findings.historicalRotation: No recurring event series or destination/venue rotation established. The operational start on 17 August 2026 and inauguration on 8 September 2026 concern the same CEDIS, not separate editions. Expansion across stores and distribution centres must not be treated as an annual event rotation.
findings.accommodationSourcing: UNKNOWN / hotel_sourcing_unconfirmed. No published hotel RFP, room block, travel-management company, PCO, accommodation agency or hotel-selection timetable was identified. FEMSA publicly directs potential goods/services suppliers to abastecimientosfemsa@femsa.com.mx; use this as a routing request, not evidence that Bara hotel procurement is open. The contact page is dated 17 December 2019 and its applicability to Bara must be confirmed.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate retailer, not an association or event agency: Tiendas Bara is a FEMSA subsidiary. FEMSA’s 2025 annual report states its decision to separate Bara administratively and operationally from OXXO México. Do not assume an OXXO supplier contact controls Bara purchasing. No event owner–PCO–hotel buyer chain was established.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced incumbent hotel, rate agreement, overflow, compression dates or displaced room demand was found. Inference: the hotel’s Expo-area location may be less suitable for CEDIS-focused visitors than a location chosen around their actual work itinerary; test travel time and budget before proposing it. The announced jobs, store counts and warehouse capacity cannot be converted into delegates or room nights.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Route this candidate out of qualified event inventory and into corporate prospecting, subject to ORS authority. Approach Willinton Giraldo Bedoya for the Jalisco expansion travel owner and Jonathan Magdaleno for local HR/training coordination; ask who actually buys lodging and meeting space. In parallel request the Bara-specific services-procurement route through FEMSA’s published supplier mailbox. Ask for November 2026–May 2028 project milestones, non-local traveller origins, stay patterns, meeting needs, approved-hotel process, incumbent agreements and renewal dates. Only then offer a Sheraton corporate-rate/meeting proposal; do not create a speculative room block.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Closed by elapsed date, not by a verified hotel contract: the one-time inauguration took place on 8 September 2026, before the requested horizon and before the 14 November 2026 assessment date. Operations began on 17 August 2026. The ceremony is not a current sales opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference only: the 2026–2031 investment programme overlaps the horizon and justifies account development for possible project visits, onboarding/training and management/supplier meetings. It does not establish recurring hotel demand, an upcoming edition, an open sourcing cycle or a competitive-capture opportunity. Advance only after the account confirms non-local travellers, dates, budget and purchasing ownership.
